about: The collecta of the formulary “Commemoration of All the Faithful Departed — Mass III” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O God, Who forgives sins and desires to save mankind, we beseech Your mercy to grant, by the intercession of Blessed Mary, ever Virgin, and that of all Your Saints, that the souls of Your servants and handmaids who have departed this life may enter upon the enjoyment of unending happiness. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
g: supreme happiness, blessedness, a blessed condition, beatitude
